title: Localization
description: UI strings used by the templates and metadata values consumed by the generator, as a map keyed by id (the string in `$t("id")$`) whose value maps a locale key to a string. Every id a page consumes must exist for that page's language (or its base language: `xx-YY` falls back to `xx`) or the build fails. The reserved `_ogLocaleDefaultRegion` key holds the full `xx_YY` locale used for `og:locale`.

_ogLocaleDefaultRegion.description: The full `xx_YY` locale used for `og:locale`, per language.
